name: supervision-js-workspace
description: Workspace for the supervision-js core and browser packages.

scripts.build: npm run build -w supervision-js-core && npm run build -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build -w supervision-js
scripts.build:js: npm run build:js -w supervision-js-core && npm run build:js -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build:js -w supervision-js
scripts.build:types: npm run build:types -w supervision-js-core && npm run build:types -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build:types -w supervision-js
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w supervision-js-core && npm run clean -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run clean -w supervision-js
scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -k -n lib,demo -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:lib" "npm run dev:demo"
scripts.dev:lib: concurrently -k -n core,rn,web -c blue,green,cyan "npm run dev -w supervision-js-core" "npm run dev -w supervision-js-react-native" "npm run dev -w supervision-js"
scripts.dev:demo-docs: npm run build && concurrently -k -n demo,docs -c magenta,blue "npm run dev:demo" "npm run docs:dev:server"
scripts.demo:dev: npm run build && npm run dev:demo
scripts.demo:build: npm run build && npm run build -w demo && npm run example:vanilla:build:app && npm run docs:build:typedoc && npm run demo:server:build
scripts.docs:build: npm run build && npm run docs:build:typedoc
scripts.example:vanilla:dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w examples/vanilla
scripts.example:vanilla:build: npm run build && npm run example:vanilla:build:app
scripts.fixture:sam3:build: npm run build && tsc --noEmit -p tools/sam3-fixture/tsconfig.json && vite build --config tools/sam3-fixture/vite.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w supervision-js-core && npm run build -w supervision-js-core && npm run typecheck -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run build -w supervision-js-react-native && npm run typecheck -w supervision-js && npm run build -w supervision-js && tsc --noEmit -p demo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/vanilla/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run package:smoke && npm run demo:build && npm run benchmark:initial:build && npm run benchmark:media-upload:build && npm run benchmark:masks:gpu:build
